verses.text: Thank the LORD because he’s good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Let Israel say it now: “His faithful love lasts forever.”
Let Aaron’s family say it now: “His faithful love lasts forever.”
Let everyone who fears the LORD say it now: “His faithful love lasts forever.”
I called to the LORD when I was in a tight spot. He answered by setting me free.
The LORD’s on my side. I won’t be afraid. What can anyone do to me?
The LORD’s right here with the people helping me. I’ll see those who hate me defeated.
It’s better to take shelter with the LORD than to put your trust in people.
It’s better to take shelter with the LORD than to put your trust in rulers.
Nations closed in around me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.
They surrounded me on every side. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
They swarmed around me like bees, then died out like a fire in dry thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.
You shoved me hard to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.
The LORD is my strength and my song. He’s the one who saved me.
Listen to the joyful shouts of victory in the tents of the righteous: “The LORD’s right hand does mighty things!
The LORD’s right hand is raised high! The LORD’s right hand does mighty things!”
I won’t die. I’ll live and tell what the LORD has done.
The LORD disciplined me hard, but he didn’t hand me over to death.
Open the gates of righteousness for me. I’ll walk through and thank the LORD.
This is the LORD’s gate. Those who do right will go in.
I’ll thank you because you answered me and saved me.
The stone the builders tossed aside has become the cornerstone.
The LORD did this, and it’s a wonder to see.
This is the day the LORD made. Let’s celebrate and be glad in it!
Please, LORD, save us now! Please, LORD, give us success now!
Blessed is the one who comes in the LORD’s name! We bless you from the LORD’s house.
The LORD is God, and he’s given us light. Tie the sacrifice with ropes, right up to the horns of the altar.
You’re my God, and I’ll thank you. You’re my God, and I’ll lift you up.
Thank the LORD because he’s good. His faithful love lasts forever.
